newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zairean government negotiator arrives in S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Zairean government negotiator arrives in S.Africa.

text.p: A Zairean government negotiator representing ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko arrived in South Africa on Thursday.
Honore Ngbanda, security adviser to Mobutu and chairman of the government team, disembarked at the Lanseria Airport outside Johannesburg.

A delegation representing rebel leader Laurent Kabila, whose forces have seized about a quarter of Zaire since October, was expected within hours of Ngbanda's arrival and was also likely to land at the small commercial Lanseria airport.
The first meeting between leaders of Zaire's warring factions is scheduled for this weekend in Pretoria or Johannesburg, both in the heartlands Gauteng province.
South African and U.N. officials met in Pretoria earlier on Thursday to wrap up arrangements for the talks.

Deputy Foreign Minister Aziz Pahad and the joint United Nations and Organisation of African Unity envoy, Mohamed Sahnoun, discussed arrangements which were likely to be made public on Friday, the Foreign Ministry in Pretoria said.
